messages:
maya: heads-up: CI perf flagged streaming decode regression after merge of PR #8540. decode_stream p99 +15% on A100. starting triage.

ryan: i can repro with tools/perf/run_stream --model gpt-medium --ctx 1536 --tokens 200 --stream. p99 ~140ms vs baseline 122ms.

ci-bot: perf-test/decode_stream failed at 1764501122. p50 +2% p90 +8% p99 +15%. flamegraph: attention_kernel_selector -> attn_generic_setup -> kv_cache_read memcpy

diego: bisecting now.

diego: bisect result: commit 5c8a2b4 (ops/attn: prefer generic kernel for seq>512) is first bad. 1764501200

maya: interesting, that change aimed for throughput on large batch long seqs.

ryan: attn_generic has extra reshape for KV that isn't amortized for batch_size=1 stream; causes memcpy per token.

diego: profiler top: attention_kernel_selector 30%, attn_generic_setup 25%, kv_cache_read memcpy 18%, attn_fused_token_path 4%

maya: quick mitigations: (1) env override REDWOOD_ATTENTION_KERNEL=attn_fused on stream pool (2) selector patch to consider request.is_stream or batch_size (3) revert commit

ryan: env override quickest. canary rollout plan?

ops-bot: launching canary: stream-pool-canary (10% traffic). monitor p99 for 20m. started at 1764501280

diego: also noticed selector uses only seq_len threshold. propose change: if request.stream or batch<=1 -> prefer attn_fused; elif seq_len>512 and batch>=4 -> attn_generic; else attn_fused

maya: filing issue with reproducer, bisect data, flames: https://go.redwood/issue/2048

ryan: will draft small PR to add request flag and env var check + unit test covering batch 1 vs batch 8.

ops-bot: canary metrics after 10m: p99 improved ~13ms on canary nodes, error rate stable. (1764501340)

diego: follow-up: commit 5c8a2b4 also reordered KV layout assumption; we should make attn_generic tolerant to both layouts to avoid memcopy. but that's medium-term.

maya: if canary stays green merge selector patch and enable env override as stopgap. schedule perf sweep across seqs 64/256/512/1024 and batches 1/4/8.

qa: will run the test matrix once the patch is in. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: canary finished 20m window at 1764501480. result: success. promoting to 50% then 100% as per rollout policy.

maya: thanks team. keep an eye on model variants and on-prem runners which may have different memory layouts.
